articles.summary: MALMÖ, Sweden, April 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY), the world’s original and largest oat drink company, has today published its Swedish annual report for the twelve months ended December 31, 2025 (the “Swedish Annual Report”).
articles.title: Oatly Publishes Swedish Annual Report for 2025

articles.summary: MALMÖ, Sweden, April 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY) (“Oatly”, the “Company” or the “Group”), the world’s original and largest oat drink company, today announced financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026.
articles.title: Oatly Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
